name: TeamStarWolf - N-able N-central Able2Shell (November 2026) Case Study
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. Enterprise ATT&CK v20.0 techniques bound in the Able2Shell case study: the November 2026 N-able N-central disclosure and the RMM landmarks that frame it (Kaseya VSA 2021, ScreenConnect 2024, SimpleHelp 2025 and the earlier N-central KEV entries). No advisory names ATT&CK ids, so every binding is the study's own. Score 100: bound to the Able2Shell record by a Confirmed primary (vendor status page and CVE records). Score 50: the researcher's claims (Reported) and RMM-landmark context. Comments carry the study's source numbers.

techniques.comment: Able2Shell record: N-able observes scanning tied to the published code (status page, 2026-11-10); Previdian decoy probing from 2026-11-09 (Demonstrated). Mapping is the study's own. Sources: [1] [3] [19].

Able2Shell record: CVE-2026-125883 and CVE-2026-125881, network vector with no privileges (CVE records, 2026-11-10); exploitation attempts against honeypots (2026-11-09 to 10, Reported); no confirmed compromise. RMM landmarks: Kaseya VSA (2021-07-02), ScreenConnect CVE-2024-1709 (KEV 2024-02-22), SimpleHelp CVE-2024-57727 (KEV 2025-02-13), N-central CVE-2026-86218 (KEV 2026-09-08). Mapping is the study's own. Sources: [4] [5] [18] [19] [45] [12] [53] [38] [59].

Able2Shell record: CVE-2026-125879 and CVE-2026-91000, local privilege escalation (CVE records, 2026-11-10); README chains 3 and 4 reach root (Reported). Mapping is the study's own. Sources: [7] [10] [14].
Reported: the README claims code execution as the appliance service account and as root (2026-11-09); the record names no interpreter, so no sub-technique. Sources: [14] [16].

Reported: the README claims chain 1 can create an enabled administrator account (2026-11-09); Huntress hunts for unauthorized new administrator accounts (2026-11-10). RMM landmark: ScreenConnect CVE-2024-1709 lets an attacker create an administrator-level account (KEV 2024-02-22). Sources: [14] [17] [12] [50].

RMM landmark: in the summer 2026 N-central intrusion the actor used Take Control to reach managed devices (N-able, 2026-07-31 onward); HF2 disables built-in remote control (2026-11-10). Mapping is the study's own. Sources: [36] [37] [2].
RMM landmark: Cloudflare tunnel services registered for persistence in the summer 2026 N-central intrusion (N-able, 2026-08-02 to 10). Mapping is the study's own. Sources: [35] [37] [42].
RMM landmark: a registered Cloudflared service among the N-central Hotfix 1 indicators (N-able, 2026-08-02); Windows service platform Inferred. Sources: [35].
